Card art benchmark

The same prompt on every OpenAI image model this project's key can call, one image each, generated on 2026-10-08. Click an image to open it at full size. The small crop is the size the art appears on a card.

The prompt
Fantasy trading card illustration.

Scene: A glass knight kneeling on a frozen ocean of fractured glass, his cracked visor reflecting a pale sun, shards drifting upward around him.

World: Glasswake. An ocean frozen into glass overnight; sailors now walk where they once drowned.

Medium: traditional oil painting in the manner of 1970s pulp fantasy paperback covers. Visible brushwork, dramatic rim lighting, deep shadows, a saturated but earthy palette, heroic composition.

Composition: wide landscape crop, one clear subject with a strong silhouette that reads at thumbnail size, uncluttered background.

Constraints: full-bleed painting only. No text, letters, borders, card frame, signature, or watermark.

  • One sample per row. Image models vary from run to run, so treat small differences as noise.
  • Cost is computed from the token usage each response reported, at OpenAI's listed per-token prices. An eight-player draft is 288 images.
  • Times are wall-clock for a single request. The five "first run" rows were requested together; the three "second run" rows were requested together later, so times are only loosely comparable across runs.
  • The 2.x models accept custom sizes, so they were run at 1008x656, the smallest size at the card's aspect ratio. The 1.x models only accept fixed sizes, so they were run at 1536x1024, which is why they use more output tokens.
